heading.title: Things I'm building.
heading.subtitle: From a knowledge initiative to a POS platform — each at a different stage.

p1.title: AVYRO
p1.description: An offline-first POS platform that syncs automatically when the connection returns. It includes an independent website per client, integrated inventory and order management, a customizable mobile app, and a central control panel to manage clients, subscriptions, and updates. Currently under development.

p2.title: Mothaqaf
p2.description: An initiative to build an educated team that thinks, learns, and leads — with practical Arabic content built on real experience from inside the work environment.

p3.title: The Guide Library
p3.description: Short, practical guides tied to videos and built on real experience in management, leadership, and decisions.
